protocol.sampling: Six complete fresh-cache trials per trace, three-branch cyclic order balanced twice. No warmup request or primed entry. Same fixed files in both branches.
protocol.timing: Sum per-request wall and process CPU time for CSV read and compute or validated features plus applied cleanup after every request. Equality checks excluded equally; input generation/reference construction excluded.
protocol.storage: 32MiB best-effort recognized-byte budget, oldest manifest eviction; explicit min_age_seconds=0 only inside disposable benchmark directories. Record temporary pre-cleanup disk peak separately.
protocol.inference: Synthetic workload on one existing cloud server. No extrapolated energy, carbon, fleet savings or OS effect. Report slowdowns and all traces; no selection of a winning workload.
